assertions.text: States that allowed-tools pre-approves tools for the turn that invokes the skill and does not restrict which tools are available, so Write remains callable and would just prompt
Classifies the missing Write grant as a tool-completeness finding about prompts, not as a blocked capability or a security boundary
Names disallowed-tools or a permission deny rule as the way to actually restrict a tool
Does not claim the skill is read-only because of its allowed-tools list
